verdict.rationale: LM Studio's homepage directly claims the story: users work with Bionic, its agent, to create and edit documents, and every change is saved automatically (lm-studio-docs-15). The docs index lists Bionic as a documented area (lm-studio-probe-2), and a hands-on user reports Bionic 'works great', though not about document editing specifically (lm-studio-comm-19). missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the document workspace and autosave behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of document drafting/editing.
